caption: Sand is sprinkled on a cymbal and a violin bow is drawn along its edge, and the sand jumps and gathers into lines.

sa.check: Sand is sprinkled onto a cymbal, or lies sprinkled on it.
A violin bow is drawn along the cymbal's edge.
The bow moves first and the sand jumps after; the lines form from the jumping.

pc.expect: The sand lies still until the bow touches the edge, hops while the bow moves and settles when it lifts.
pc.fail: Sand hops before the bow touches the cymbal; or hops while the bow is held away; or the bow is drawn and the sand lies dead still; or the sand goes on hopping well after the bow has lifted.

pc.expect: The hopping gathers the sand into lines or patches that stay after the bow lifts; no pattern exists before the bowing.
pc.fail: Lines appear fully formed before or without any hopping; or a pattern forms and then dissolves back to an even sprinkle while the sand is still; or the pattern slides as a whole around the cymbal like a picture.

pc.expect: Grains fall back onto the cymbal or off its edge.
pc.fail: Grains hang in the air; or float up; or grains that fell off return up onto the cymbal.

pc.expect: The cymbal is a rigid metal disc that may wobble; the bow is rigid; the grains stay separate.
pc.fail: The cymbal ripples like water; or the bow bends double; or the sand flows as a liquid puddle.

pc.expect: One cymbal, one bow; the sand keeps its amount, allowing for grains falling off.
pc.fail: Sand appears from nowhere; or all the sand vanishes; or the bow passes through the cymbal; or the cymbal changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cymbal's colour, the bow's length and the stand stay the same.
pc.fail: The cymbal changes colour; or the bow changes length; or the stand changes.

note: The hand on the bow is a trigger and is not judged.
